newsitem.title: JAPAN: Motor racing-Nissan to develop new car for Le Mans.
newsitem.headline: Motor racing-Nissan to develop new car for Le Mans.

text.p: Nissan said on Friday it would develop a new GT car for the Le Mans 24-hour sportscar race in France next June.
The new car, to be named a Nissan R390 GT1, will be powered by a Nissan-developed 3.5-litre twin-turbo V-8 engine and will be styled like a prototype sports car.
Nissan has yet to detail its entries for next year's Le Mans but three of the new cars will participate in the GT1 category of the race, a company spokeswoman said.
Porsche TWR won the endurance race last year.
